messages:
Sara CSM: Heads-up — prepping mid-year QBR for Acadia. Need a concise rundown on account health + token econ by EOD Thursday. Main asks: 1) 90-day spend forecast (tokens + $) 2) Any active budget alerts or credit thresholds 3) Onboarding enablement status and blockers 4) Renewal risk signals (feature activation, usage churn). Can FinOps + Data collate?

Liam FinOps: On it. Quick note — their embedding throughput doubled after the nightly index job last week, so week-over-week looks spiky. I'll pull a smoothing view.

Ben Data: Quick draft numbers (rough):
```
90-day forecast tokens: M1 1.15M, M2 1.4M, M3 1.25M
90-day forecast $: M1 $9,200, M2 $11,200, M3 $10,000
Breakdown drivers: embeddings 60%, gen 30%, rerank 10%
```
Ben Data: Also flagged anomaly: index job retried N times on 03/14 -> approx +180k extra tokens that day. I'll show 7d vs 30d to highlight volatility.

Maria Onboarding: Enablement status: API walkthrough complete; only 2 of 6 product teams actively using contextual embeddings. Recommend a 30-min tactical session on RAG patterns, batching, and cache TTLs pre-QBR to reduce token waste. I can host Mon or Tue.

Arjun CS: Renewal risk score ~48% (medium). Signals: rising spend without broad feature adoption, low MAP engagement, upcoming NPS. Positives: they opted into a Dedicated trial and gave engineering access to the SDK. For QBR, emphasize cost optimization levers (batching, prefix caching, quantization).

billing-bot: Billing alert posted to #customer-success: Acadia (acct AC-834) at 85% of monthly commit. Link: https://billing.example/ac-834

Liam FinOps: Budget note — 85% threshold hit; not immediate overage but worth a proactive action item. Recommended quick wins: adjust embedding batch size, enable prefix caching for common queries, consider quantized model for heavy embedding pipelines (~20-30% unit cost reduction).

Sara CSM: Action items:
- Liam: finalize 90-day forecast + 1-slide sensitivity (best/base/worst) — due Thu EOD.
- Ben: 1-slide usage driver breakdown + anomaly annotation.
- Maria: schedule 30-min enablement session and send invite to Acadia POCs.
- Arjun: draft renewal risk summary + suggested play (optimization audit + proposed Dedicated pilot expansion).

Ben Data: I'll include a small table and the anomaly note. Also will add a simple waterfall showing where tokens are spent.

Liam FinOps: I'll formalize assumptions and include an estimated $ savings if cache hit improves by 20%. Preliminary calc: 20% cache improvement -> ~18% token cost reduction -> ~$1.6k/month saved (base).

Arjun CS: I'll plug that savings into the renewal uplift narrative (e.g., 10-15% higher renewal probability if runway improved).

Maria Onboarding: Sent doodle for Mon 10:30 / Tue 3:00.

Sara CSM: Thanks everyone. I'll assemble the QBR deck draft once slides arrive. Ping here if you need sign-off on the final slide copy. :thumbsup:
